exposure: number of pharmacological treatment cycles for patent ductus arteriosus
outcome: length of stay in the neonatal intensive care unit
hemodynamic disturbances or complications during and after patent ductus arteriosus ligation surgery
cohort: 24 premature babies born at or before 30 weeks of gestation transferred to the neonatal intensive care unit for bedside patent ductus arteriosus ligation
finding: Prolonging pharmacological treatment for patent ductus arteriosus in order to avoid surgery increases the risk of severe bronchopulmonary dysplasia and prolongs hospital stay.
